resolvedQuestions.text: Which MCP 2.0 actions are read-only, draft-safe, destructive, publish-capable, or deployment-capable?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Read-only: all GET actions + ask_webflow_ai + webflow_guide_tool + element_snapshot. Draft-safe: CMS/page/component/script/Designer canvas mutations (publish always explicit). Destructive: delete_collection_items, delete_all_site/page_scripts, delete_webhook, delete_301_redirect, delete_robots_txt, remove_well_known_files, delete_variable, remove_element/attribute/style, unregister_component. Publish-capable: publish_site, publish_collection_items, update_page_settings (status field). Deployment-capable: run_workflow.

resolvedQuestions.text: Does the official surface use remote OAuth, a local server, an API token, or a client-specific connection flow?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Remote OAuth (mcp.webflow.com/sse via experimental mcp-remote; per-site/workspace authorization; owner/admin role gate) OR local server with WEBFLOW_TOKEN bearer token (site or workspace token). No client-specific flow.

resolvedQuestions.text: What non-production Webflow workspace or site can support live smoke?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Dedicated test workspace (authz isolation, owner/admin gate) + small Starter test site; read-only scopes baseline; publish smoke limited to publishToWebflowSubdomain (webflow.io staging), single page via pageId, 1/min; production site never authorized.

resolvedQuestions.text: Is mcp-webflow a workflow or a transport?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Transport: mutatesWorkspace:false, mutations land in Webflow cloud via Data API v2 + Designer API; transport-axis leaf with mandatory sk-design pairing; run_workflow executes Webflow-side workflows, not repo-side operations.

resolvedQuestions.text: Which Webflow operations require explicit operator confirmation, and which require a named rollback?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Confirmation: publish-capable (publish_site, publish_collection_items, update_page_settings status flip), destructive (CMS/scripts/webhook/redirect/robots/variable/element deletes), deployment-capable (run_workflow). Rollback: re-PUT/re-create for most; API-level site restore UNKNOWN.

resolvedQuestions.text: Which operations must pair with sk-design design judgment?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Designer family (deElement/deStyle/deVariable/deComponents/deAsset/dePages + update_static_content DOM updates) pairs with sk-design; Data family (CMS content, settings, publish, scripts, webhooks, workflows, comments, enterprise) does not.

keyFindings.finding: Official server webflow/mcp-server (npm webflow-mcp-server 1.0.1, MIT); MCP SDK 1.25.2 + webflow-api 3.2.1
Translation-layer architecture wrapping REST Data + Designer APIs into MCP tools
Two deployment modes: remote OAuth (mcp.webflow.com/sse, mcp-remote experimental) and local npx webflow-mcp-server with WEBFLOW_TOKEN
18 tool modules in src/tools/; de* prefix + localDeMCPConnection are Designer/bridge-bound
Bridge App optional for most actions; required only for canvas-bound ops (current canvas/selection/page/mode/branch/breakpoints)
MCP 2.0 headline: components from screenshot, full CSS variable collection access, per-site Agent Instructions (rules+skills), plain-language analytics
Node.js 22.3.0+ required; OAuth reset rm -rf ~/.mcp-auth; docs via llms.txt + .md suffix
Combined-tool pattern: one MCP tool per module, per-action schemas with HTTP-method comments; readOnlyHint false on combined tools, true on element_snapshot/webflow_guide/ask_webflow_ai
Operation classes: publish_site + publish_collection_items + update_page_settings(status) are publish-capable; run_workflow deployment-capable; CMS/scripts/enterprise deletes destructive
Designer tool family (de_*, element_*, style_, variable_, asset_) is canvas-draft via bridge app; not publish-capable itself
comments tool fully read-only (3 GET actions); webhooks CRUD; enterprise plan tools for 301 redirects/robots.txt/well-known/activity logs; ask_webflow_ai read-only chat
Remote OAuth (mcp.webflow.com/sse, mcp-remote experimental); per-site/workspace browser authorization; token at ~/.mcp-auth; only site owners/admins can authorize
Local mode: WEBFLOW_TOKEN bearer; token types Site (single site), Workspace (enterprise, workspace_activity:read only, no site scope), OAuth (multi-site user-specific)

Site-level scopes paired read/write: assets, cms, comments, components, custom_code (Data Client apps only), ecommerce, forms, pages, sites, site_config, users, webhooks, workspace; site_activity:read
Rate limits plan-based per API key: 60 rpm Starter/Basic, 120 rpm CMS/eCommerce/Business, Enterprise custom; publish 1/min; 429 + Retry-After; SDK exponential backoff
Publish endpoint: site OR page (pageId), customDomains or publishToWebflowSubdomain required, sites:write scope, 202 async, 1 publish/min
Staging semantics: page-level staging publishes accumulate; staging->production publishes all staged changes; publishToWebflowSubdomain = webflow.io non-production path
update_page_settings can flip page publishing status (draft/published) - publish-capable settings mutation
Q4 test target: dedicated test workspace + small Starter test site, read-only scope baseline, publish smoke to webflow.io subdomain single page, never authorize production site
Q5 classes: publish/destructive/deploy actions confirmation-gated; rollback via re-PUT/re-create; API-level site restore UNKNOWN in Data API v2
Q3: mcp-webflow is a TRANSPORT (mutatesWorkspace:false; mutations land in Webflow cloud); transport-axis leaf with sk-design pairing
Q6: Designer family (deElement/deStyle/deVariable/deComponents/deAsset/dePages + update_static_content) pairs with sk-design; Data family does not
Q5: confirmation-gated = publish-capable + destructive + run_workflow; rollback via re-PUT/re-create; API-level site restore UNKNOWN
